name: example-missing-samples-demo
description: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE ONLY - not a recommendation. Values are chosen to straddle the observed soak plateaus so the tool's behaviour is visible; they are derived from no limit or safety analysis. The same hottest-channel VRAM rule (80 C, persistence 5 s) three times, differing only in missing-sample handling. Meant to be run with --drop to inject a SYNTHETIC in-memory dropout; the raw evidence has no missing samples.
